messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 -> runtime-serving-prod (container crashloop)
incident-bot: Alert details: 24 pods failing across 3 AZs, crashloop backoff, recent deployment: trt-fused-kernel:v2.3.4 rolled 20m ago
incident-bot: Symptoms: SIGSEGV in engine.so stack trace present in pod logs, core dumps being generated; affected routing: production model-family 'redwood-turbo' on Dedicated and Hosted fallback

mike-oncall: ack. I'm on it. tagging @jamie-runtime and @elaine-sre. what's the customer impact so far? :rotating_light:

jamie-runtime: seeing `Segmentation fault (core dumped)` inside container logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T18:03:12Z] engine: runtime/engine.cpp:324 handle_attention(): segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f2a3b4f ret 0x7f2a3b5a
Backtrace:
  #0 0x7f2a3b4f in fused_attention::forward()
  #1 0x7f2a1c2a in run_inference
  #2 0x55a2f9e5 in main
```
Also saw same SIGSEGV in 3 different kernel builds (trt-fused-v2.3.4) across GCP-us-central1-a/b/c nodes

elaine-sre: confirmed core dumps exist on node gpu-usr-12. I've copied one to /tmp/core-dumps for inspection. Looks like the fused attention path deref'd a null KV pointer.

mike-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic off problematic replicas -> set rollout to fallback model-variant (redwood-turbo-safe). 2) disable fused kernel via env flag on runtime deployment `REDWOOD_FUSED_KERNEL=false`. 3) rollback image to trt-fused-v2.3.3 if disable flag insufficient. 4) cordon suspected nodes and drain if cores keep appearing.

cody-support: customer impact: we've seen ~6% of API calls return 502/503 last 15m. Dedicated customer ACME Corp (org-acme) reporting degraded throughput for batch endpoints. CS opened ticket #INC-5872. I'll attach logs and ETA updates.

jamie-runtime: running hot-config to set env: 
```
kubectl -n runtime set env deployment/runtime-serving REDWOOD_FUSED_KERNEL=false --record
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deployment/runtime-serving
```
Applying now.

mike-oncall: also scaling up safe-path pool to soak traffic: 
```
kubectl -n runtime scale deployment/runtime-serving-safe --replicas=10
```
Routing change pushed to traffic-router to prefer safe pool.

incident-bot: Action log: env toggle applied by jamie-runtime at 2026031520; rollout started.

jamie-runtime: after disabling fused kernel, ~8 of 24 pods still crashlooping but logs now show different stack (fallback slow path) for some, success in others. Looks like mixed state due to old pods on nodes not yet restarted.

luca-eng: I'm going to roll back the image on the runtime cluster to trt-fused-v2.3.3 on a canary subset: 
```
kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/runtime-serving runtime=registry.redwood/trt-fused:v2.3.3-canary
kubectl -n runtime rollout status deployment/runtime-serving --watch
```
I'll hold at canary=3 pods for 5m and validate.

elaine-sre: cordoning gpu-usr-12 and draining one node with repeated cores. 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-usr-12
kubectl drain gpu-usr-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Node cordoned, pods rescheduled.

jamie-runtime: note — core analysis (quick): 
```
$ gdb -c /tmp/core-dumps/core.engine --batch -ex "bt full" -ex "quit"
# shows null deref at fused_attention::forward when kv_cache.size()==0
```
Potential regression in KV cache handling when sequence length==0 for certain batched requests.

mike-oncall: good triage. For immediate comms: Cody, can you post an incident banner to status page that we have degraded inference for some customers with workaround in progress? include ETA 30-45m. @tanya-product to prep customer comms for top-tier accounts.

cody-support: posting status: "We are investigating degraded performance for inference; temporary mitigation applied (fallback model and kernel toggle). Working on image rollback. ETA 45m." I'll ping account owners once we see stable rates.

tanya-product: acknowledged. I'll coordinate a short note to enterprise contacts. mention dedicated customers may see increased latency.

jamie-runtime: can confirm canary rollback pods (v2.3.3) are steady after 3m smoke tests. No segfaults on those canary pods. Running load test 50 RPS for 5m.

incident-bot: Canary load test results: 0 segfaults on 3 canary pods over 5m. Safety threshold met.

luca-eng: initiating progressive rollback to v2.3.3 cluster-wide while keeping REDWOOD_FUSED_KERNEL=false to be extra safe: 
```
kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/runtime-serving runtime=registry.redwood/trt-fused:v2.3.3
kubectl -n runtime rollout status deployment/runtime-serving
```
Rolling now.

jamie-runtime: I'm tailing logs; crashloop count dropping from 24 -> 4 -> 0 over the last 12 minutes.

elaine-sre: nodes with cores have been tainted `taint gpu-redwood/crash:NoSchedule` to avoid scheduling until debug complete. cores persisted -> we'll collect full set and hand to eng for deep-dive.

mike-oncall: handoff soon. @jamie-runtime can you summarize actions taken and immediate next steps so I can capture in incident timeline? I'll stay on until wrap.

jamie-runtime: summary: 
- Root symptom: SIGSEGV in fused_attention path after trt-fused-kernel:v2.3.4 rollout (20m).
- Immediate mitigations: toggled REDWOOD_FUSED_KERNEL=false, scaled safe pool, cordoned/drained affected nodes, rolled back image to v2.3.3, tainted nodes with repeated cores.
- Current state (2026031526): rollout to v2.3.3 complete, crashloops resolved, 0 segfaults in last 10m, traffic back to normal but some latency increase due to fallback and older kernels.
- Next steps: eng-runtime (luca, jamie) to analyze core dumps and reproduce locally, add regression test for kv_cache empty seq edge-case, consider hotfix for fused kernel, add guard/early-return in fused_attention.

luca-eng: I'll take lead on analysis. grabbing cores and reproducing in docker with same build flags. creating follow-up ticket ENG-8671 for root-cause and patch.

cody-support: CS notified ACME with interim update; they acknowledged. I'll update ticket with rollback details and ETA for full RCA once ENG-8671 has milestones.

mike-oncall: great. incident status -> degraded -> mitigated, moving to monitoring. keeping this thread open for handoff notes. I'll log timeline in incident doc and create postmortem stub. Thanks all. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident action: SEV2 -> Mitigated at 2026031527 by mike-oncall. Postmortem requested. Link: https://redwood.company/incidents/20260315-segfault-kernel-hotpatch

elaine-sre: leaving post-handoff note: collected cores, nodal kernel and driver versions, GPU runtimes, and build metadata. Dropping blobs in S3 path s3://redwood-ops/incident-20260315/ for eng.

mike-oncall: handoff complete. @luca-eng and @jamie-runtime own RCA. I'll update stakeholders and close after postmortem.
